newsitem.title: USA: U.S. zinc output climbs in September from August.
newsitem.headline: U.S. zinc output climbs in September from August.

text.p: U.S. zinc slab production in September rose to 19,548 short tons from 15,603 short tons in August and 18,529 short tons in September last year, said American Bureau of Metal Statistics.
Production in the first nine months of the year totaled 173,020 short tons, down from 180,903 short tons in the same period last year.
Shipments from plants totaled 18,494 short tons in September, up from 15,640 in August, but slightly lower than the 18,710 short tons shipped in September 1995.
Zinc slab inventory rose to 5,584 short tons in September, up from 4,507 tons in August, but down from 6,638 tons in September 1995.
